label: Suprema BioStation / XPass SDK (SrFace / SrOcs)
_comment: Suprema distributes its device SDKs only through registered partners / the BioStar support portal (login required) — no public direct download. Obtain the SDK from your Suprema reseller, drop the DLL + this manifest into enrollment-bridge\sdk\ and POST /sdk/rescan. Export names vary between SrFace vs BioStationAPI generations: edit 'probe'/'capture' to match the header of the package you received.
